outcome.answer: Altmann’s paper is Quantum Generator Kernels [1]. It proposes Quantum Generator Kernels, a generator-based approach to quantum kernels using Variational Generator Groups, and reports improved projection and classification performance over state-of-the-art quantum and classical kernel methods [1]. None of the other papers directly address Altmann’s quantum generator kernels [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10].
